title: 2026 Roadmap on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning for Smart Manufacturing
comment: This paper has been accepted for publication in the Journal Machine Learning: Engineering
summary: The evolution of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) is reshaping smart manufacturing by providing new capabilities for efficiency, adaptability, and autonomy across industrial value chains. However, the deployment of AI and ML in industrial settings still faces critical challenges, including the complexity of industrial big data, effective data management, integration with heterogeneous sensing and control systems, and the demand for trustworthy, explainable, and reliable operation in high-stakes industrial environments. In this roadmap, we present a comprehensive perspective on the foundations, applications, and emerging directions of AI and ML in smart manufacturing. It is structured in three parts. The first highlights the foundations and trends that frame the evolution of AI in smart manufacturing. The second focuses on key topics where AI is already enabling advances, including industrial big data analytics, advanced sensing and perception, autonomous systems, additive and laser-based manufacturing, digital twins, robotics, supply chain and logistics optimization, and sustainable manufacturing. The third section explores non-traditional ML approaches that are opening new frontiers, such as physics-informed AI, generative AI, semantic AI, advanced digital twins, explainable AI, RAMS, data-centric metrology, LLMs, and foundation models for highly connected and complex manufacturing systems. By identifying both opportunities and remaining barriers across these areas, this roadmap outlines the advances needed in methods, integration strategies, and industrial adoption. We hope this roadmap will serve as a guide for researchers, engineers, and practitioners to accelerate innovation, align academic and industrial priorities, and ensure that AI-driven smart manufacturing delivers reliable, sustainable, and scalable impact for the future of manufacturing ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 本文全面综述了AI/ML在智能制造中的基础、应用和新兴方向，涵盖工业大数据、感知系统、自主系统、数字孪生、机器人、供应链优化及可持续制造等关键领域，并探讨了物理信息AI、生成式AI、语义AI、可解释AI、大语言模型等前沿技术，提出了应对工业部署挑战的技术路线图。
AI.motivation: AI/ML在智能制造中虽潜力巨大，但仍面临工业大数据复杂性、异构传感控制系统集成、可信赖性与可解释性等关键挑战，亟需系统性路线图指导研究与产业应用。
AI.method: 采用三部分结构化路线图方法：第一部分阐述AI在智能制造中的基础与趋势；第二部分聚焦当前AI已推动进步的关键主题（大数据分析、感知、自主系统等）；第三部分探索非传统ML新前沿（物理信息AI、生成式AI、语义AI、可解释AI、LLMs及基础模型等）。
AI.result: 识别出各领域的机会与障碍，提出了在方法、集成策略和工业采用方面所需推进的方向，为加速AI驱动智能制造创新提供了系统性指导。
AI.conclusion: 该路线图为研究人员和工程师提供了AI驱动智能制造的全面指南，旨在加速创新、对齐学术与产业优先事项，确保智能制造生态系统的可靠、可持续和可扩展发展。

title: AI Agents for Sustainable SMEs: A Green ESG Assessment Framework
summary: This study presents a novel, AI-driven framework for assessing Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) performance in European small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). An initial phase established expert-validated ESG baseline scores from a subset of the Flash Eurobarometer FL549 survey data. In the second phase, a scalable AI agent system, built on the n8n automation platform, applied these baselines to perform automated ESG classification and generate contextual recommendations using large language models (LLMs). The results demonstrate the AI system's high consistency with human-derived outputs, thereby supporting more effective monitoring and intervention strategies aligned with the European Green Deal.

AI.conclusion: 该AI驱动框架能够有效支持欧洲中小企业的ESG绩效监测和干预，符合欧洲绿色协议的目标，具有可扩展性和实际应用价值。

title: Understanding Emergent Misalignment via Feature Superposition Geometry
summary: Emergent misalignment, where fine-tuning on narrow, non-harmful tasks induces harmful behaviors, poses a key challenge for AI safety in LLMs. Despite growing empirical evidence, its underlying mechanism remains unclear. To uncover the reason behind this phenomenon, we propose a geometric account based on the geometry of feature superposition. Because features are encoded in overlapping representations, fine-tuning that amplifies a target feature also unintentionally strengthens nearby harmful features in accordance with their similarity. We give a simple gradient-level derivation of this effect and empirically test it in multiple LLMs (Gemma-2 2B/9B/27B, LLaMA-3.1 8B, GPT-OSS 20B). Using sparse autoencoders (SAEs), we identify features tied to misalignment-inducing data and to harmful behaviors, and show that they are geometrically closer to each other than features derived from non-inducing data. This trend generalizes across domains (e.g., health, career, legal advice). Finally, we show that a geometry-aware approach, filtering training samples closest to toxic features, reduces misalignment by 34.5%, substantially outperforming random removal and achieving comparable or slightly lower misalignment than LLM-as-a-judge-based filtering. Our study links emergent misalignment to feature superposition, providing a basis for understanding and mitigating this phenomenon.

title: ClinicBot: A Guideline-Grounded Clinical Chatbot with Prioritized Evidence RAG and Verifiable Citations
summary: Clinical diagnosis requires answers that are accurate, verifiable, and explicitly grounded in official guidelines. While large language models excel at natural language processing, their tendency to hallucinate undermines their utility in high-stakes medical contexts where precision is essential. Existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems treat all evidence equally, producing noisy context and generic answers misaligned with clinical practice. We present ClinicBot, an AI system that translates guideline recommendations into trustworthy clinical support through three key advances: (1) structured extraction of clinical guidelines into semantic units (recommendations, tables, definitions, narrative) with explicit provenance, (2) evidence prioritization that ranks content by clinical significance and guideline structure rather than textual similarity, and (3) a web-based interface that presents concise, actionable answers with verifiable evidence. We will demonstrate ClinicBot using diabetes questions from real patients and an additional diabetes risk assessment tool that is faithful to the American Diabetes Association (ADA) Standards of Care in Diabetes (2025). The demonstration will illustrate how semantic knowledge extraction and hierarchical evidence ranking can reliably operate in a multi-agent setting to process complex clinical guidelines at scale.

AI.motivation: 大语言模型在医疗领域存在幻觉问题，现有RAG系统平等对待所有证据，产生的上下文嘈杂且答案与临床实践不符，无法满足高精度医疗场景需求。
AI.method: (1)将临床指南结构化提取为语义单元（建议、表格、定义、叙述）并保留来源；(2)基于临床重要性和指南结构而非文本相似度对证据进行排序；(3)构建Web界面呈现简洁、可操作的答案及可验证证据；采用多智能体架构处理复杂临床指南。
AI.result: 使用真实患者的糖尿病问题及基于ADA 2025标准的糖尿病风险评估工具进行展示，验证了语义知识提取和分级证据排序在多智能体环境下大规模处理临床指南的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: ClinicBot通过结构化指南提取和分层证据排序，将指南建议转化为可信的临床支持，为高精度医疗AI系统提供了新的范式。

title: Accelerating battery research with an AI interface between FINALES and Kadi4Mat
comment: Main manuscript: 21 pages, 9 figures. Supporting material: 3 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to "Batteries & Supercaps", currently under revision
summary: The time-consuming formation process critically impacts the longevity of sodium-ion coin cells and End Of Life (EOL) performance. This study aims to optimize formation protocols for duration efficiency, targeting high-performance outcomes while minimizing the number of experiments to reduce resource consumption and accelerate discovery. Specifically, we consider two potentially competing objectives: minimizing formation time and maximizing EOL performance. Beyond this application focus, we also present a methodological contribution: a framework designed to enable interoperability between the FINALES and Kadi RDM ecosystems, which we employ to tackle our optimization problem. In this setup, the FINALES framework orchestrates experiment planning and execution on the POLiS MAP, while an active-learning agent implemented within Kadi4Mat guides experiment selection, using multi-objective batched Bayesian optimization to efficiently explore the parameter space. This interoperability enhancement enables coordinated, distributed collaboration across automated systems and human-operated workflows, bridging multiple research centers. Using this approach, we iteratively explore the trade-off between formation time and EOL performance and identify candidate solutions approximating the Pareto front. The resulting workflow demonstrates the capability of interoperable infrastructures to facilitate data-driven optimization in battery research, and establishes a transferable framework applicable to diverse materials science and engineering optimization tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种跨平台互操作性框架（FINALES + Kadi RDM），通过多目标贝叶斯优化，在减少实验次数的前提下，高效探索钠离子扣式电池化成时间与寿命（EOL）性能之间的权衡，并逼近Pareto前沿。
AI.motivation: 化成过程耗时且严重影响钠离子电池寿命与EOL性能，传统方法实验量大、资源消耗高，亟需一种高效优化化成协议的方法。
AI.method: 构建FINALES与Kadi RDM生态系统的互操作性框架：FINALES负责实验规划与执行（POLiS MAP平台），Kadi4Mat内的主动学习代理采用多目标批处理贝叶斯优化，迭代探索化成时间与EOL性能的权衡空间。
AI.result: 成功识别出逼近Pareto前沿的候选解决方案，证明了互操作基础设施在电池研究中的数据驱动优化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该互操作框架可迁移至其他材料科学与工程优化任务，为跨中心、跨自动/人工工作流的分布式协作提供了可复用的方案。

title: Effect-Transparent Governance for AI Workflow Architectures: Semantic Preservation, Expressive Minimality, and Decidability Boundaries
summary: We present a machine-checked formalization of structurally governed AI workflow architectures and prove that effect-level governance can be imposed without reducing internal computational expressivity. Using Interaction Trees in Rocq 8.19, we define a governance operator G that mediates all effectful directives, including memory access, external calls, and oracle (LLM) queries. Our development compiles with 0 admitted lemmas and consists of 36 modules, ~12,000 lines of Rocq, and 454 theorems. We establishseven properties: (P1) governed Turing completeness, (P2) governed oracle expressivity, (P3) a decidability boundary in which governance predicates are total and closed under Boolean composition while semantic program properties remain non-trivial and undecidable by governance, (P4) goal preservation for permitted executions, (P5) expressive minimality of primitive capabilities (compute, memory, reasoning, external call, observability), (P6) subsumption asymmetry showing structural governance strictly subsumes content-level filtering, and (P7) semantic transparency: on all executions where governance permits, the governed interpretation is observationally equivalent (modulo governance-only events) to the ungoverned interpretation. Together, these results show that governance and computational expressivity are orthogonal dimensions: governance constrains the effect boundary of programs while remaining semantically transparent to internal computation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Rocq形式化验证，证明了一种结构化AI工作流治理框架G，可在不影响内部计算表达能力的前提下，对效果边界进行约束，并建立了7项关键性质。
AI.motivation: 现有AI工作流治理方法往往牺牲计算表达能力或引入不可判定的语义约束，缺乏形式化保证。作者希望证明治理与计算表达能力是正交维度，可以在不损失表达能力的前提下实现效果级治理。
AI.method: 使用Rocq 8.19和Interaction Trees定义治理算子G，对内存访问、外部调用和LLM预言机查询等效果指令进行中介；通过36个模块、约12,000行代码和454个定理进行形式化证明。
AI.result: 建立了7项形式化性质：治理图灵完备性、治理预言机表达能力、可判定性边界、目标保持、原始能力的最小表达性、结构治理严格优于内容级过滤、以及语义透明性。
AI.conclusion: 治理与计算表达能力是正交维度：治理约束程序的效果边界，同时对内部计算保持语义透明。
idea_en: A method for enforcing effect-level governance on AI workflows using Interaction Trees, where a governance operator G mediates all effectful directives including memory access, external calls, and LLM oracle queries, achieving governed Turing completeness without reducing expressivity.

A formal system for structural AI workflow governance that achieves semantic transparency, where governed interpretation is observationally equivalent to ungoverned interpretation on all permitted executions (modulo governance-only events), enabling governance to constrain effect boundaries without altering internal computation semantics.

A governance architecture establishing a decidability boundary where governance predicates are total and closed under Boolean composition, while semantic program properties remain non-trivial and undecidable by governance, separating governance decisions from program semantics.

A method demonstrating subsumption asymmetry where structural governance strictly subsumes content-level filtering, providing a formal proof that structural effect-boundary governance is strictly more expressive than content-based filtering approaches.

title: Algebraic Semantics of Governed Execution: Monoidal Categories, Effect Algebras, and Coterminous Boundaries
comment: 26 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Companion proofs: https://github.com/mashin-live/governance-proofs. Project: https://mashin.live
summary: We present an algebraic semantics for governed execution in which governance is axiomatized, compositional, and coterminous with expressibility. The framework, mechanized in 32 Rocq modules (~12,000 lines, 454 theorems, 0 admitted), is built on interaction trees and parameterized coinduction. A three-axiom GovernanceAlgebra record (safety, transparency, properness) induces a symmetric monoidal category with verified pentagon, triangle, and hexagon coherence, where every tensor composition preserves governance. An algebraic effect system constrains the handler algebra so that only governance-preserving handlers can be constructed in the safe fragment; programs in the empty capability set provably emit only observability directives. Capability-indexed composition bundles programs with machine-checked capability bounds, and a dual guarantee theorem establishes that within_caps and gov_safe hold simultaneously under all composition operators. The capstone result is the coterminous boundary: within our formal model, every program expressible via the four primitive morphism constructors is governed under interpretation, and every governed program is the image of such a program. Turing completeness is preserved inside governance; unmediated I/O is excluded from the governed fragment. Governance denial is modeled as safe coinductive divergence. The governance algebra is parametric: any system instantiating the three axioms inherits all derived properties, including convergence, compositional closure, and goal preservation. Extracted OCaml runs as a NIF in the BEAM runtime, with property-based testing (70,000+ random inputs, zero disagreements) confirming behavioral equivalence between the specification and the runtime interpreter.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于代数语义的管辖执行框架，通过三公理管辖代数、效果系统和能力索引组合，在交互树和参数化余归纳的形式化模型中实现了管辖与可表达性的共延性，并在BEAM运行时中通过提取的OCaml代码验证了行为等价性。
AI.motivation: 现有形式化方法中，管辖（governance）缺乏代数化、组合性的公理基础，且管辖与程序可表达性之间的关系未被严格刻画。作者希望建立一个同时满足安全性、透明性和适切性公理的形式化框架，使管辖内生于程序的表达能力之中。
AI.method: 基于交互树（interaction trees）和参数化余归纳（parameterized coinduction），定义GovernanceAlgebra记录（三公理：安全性、透明性、适切性），诱导出对称幺半范畴并验证五边形、三角形、六边形协调性。通过代数效果系统约束处理器代数，仅允许管辖保持的处理器在安全片段中构造。能力索引组合将程序与机器检查的能力边界捆绑，双重保证定理证明within_caps和gov_safe在所有组合算子下同时成立。共延性边界定理刻画了可表达性与管辖之间的等价关系。图灵完备性在管辖内保持，非中介I/O被排除在管辖片段之外。管辖拒绝被建模为安全的余归纳发散。
AI.result: 在32个Rocq模块（约12000行，454个定理，0个待证明）中机械化实现。提取的OCaml代码作为NIF运行在BEAM运行时上，通过70000+随机输入的性质测试验证了规约与运行时解释器之间的行为等价性（零分歧）。
AI.conclusion: 管辖代数具有参数化特性：任何实例化三公理的系统继承所有派生性质，包括收敛性、组合封闭性和目标保持性。该框架为管辖执行提供了严格的代数基础，实现了管辖与可表达性的共延性，同时保留了图灵完备性。

A capability-indexed composition mechanism that bundles programs with machine-checked capability bounds, with a dual guarantee theorem ensuring within_caps and gov_safe hold simultaneously under all composition operators.

title: A Knowledge-Driven LLM-Based Decision-Support System for Explainable Defect Analysis and Mitigation Guidance in Laser Powder Bed Fusion
summary: This work presents a knowledge-driven decision-support system that integrates structured defect knowledge with LLM-based reasoning to provide explainable defect diagnosis and mitigation guidance in manufacturing, using LPBF as a representative, safety-critical case study. The proposed ontology-integrated LLM-based decision support system for LPBF defect analysis and mitigation guidance is built on a knowledge base containing 27 known LPBF defect types organized into hierarchical categories and causal relationships. The developed system supports fuzzy natural language queries for systematic knowledge retrieval, literature-supported explanation of defects, and guidance on defect causes and mitigation strategies derived from encoded process knowledge. Furthermore, a multimodal image-assessment module based on foundation models enables descriptor-guided interpretation of representative microscopic defect images through semantic alignment scoring. The proposed framework was evaluated through qualitative comparisons with general-purpose vision-language models, an ablation study, and an inter-rater reliability analysis. Evaluation on the literature-derived dataset showed that the fully integrated configuration outperformed the other three evaluated system configurations, achieving a macro-average F1 score of 0.808. Additionally, inter-rater reliability analysis using Cohen's kappa indicated substantial agreement between the model outputs and the literature-derived reference labels. These findings suggest that ontology-guided knowledge representation can improve the consistency, interpretability, and practical usefulness of LLM-assisted LPBF defect analysis.

title: Virtual Speech Therapist: A Clinician-in-the-Loop AI Speech Therapy Agent for Personalized and Supervised Therapy
summary: This paper develops Virtual Speech Therapist (VST), an intelligent agent-based platform that streamlines stuttering assessment and delivers customized therapy planning through automated and adaptive AI-driven workflows. VST integrates state-of-the-art deep learning-based stuttering classification, and multi-agent large language model (LLM) reasoning to support evidence-based clinical decision-making. The VST begins with the acquisition and feature extraction of patient speech samples, followed by robust classification of stuttering types. Building on these outputs, VST initiates an agentic reasoning process in which specialized LLM agents autonomously generate, critique, and iteratively refine individualized therapy plans. A dedicated critic agent evaluates all generated therapy plans to ensure clinical safety, methodological soundness, and alignment with peer-reviewed evidence and established professional guidelines. The resulting output is a comprehensive, patient-specific therapy draft intended for clinician review. Incorporating clinician feedback, the system then produces a finalized therapy plan suitable for patient delivery, thereby maintaining a clinician-in-the-loop paradigm. Experimental evaluation by expert speech therapists confirms that VST consistently generates high-quality, evidence-based therapy recommendations. These findings demonstrate the system's potential to augment clinical workflows, reduce clinician burden, and improve therapeutic outcomes for individuals with speech impairments. An interactive user interface for the proposed system is available online at: https://vocametrix.com/ai/stuttering-therapy-planning-agent , facilitating real-time stuttering assessment and personalized therapy planning.

title: Towards Multi-Agent Autonomous Reasoning in Hydrodynamics
summary: Single-agent systems (SAS) have become the default pattern for LLM-driven scientific workflows, but routing planning, tool use, and synthesis through a single context window comes with a well-known cost: as tool specifications and observational traces accumulate, the effective context available for each decision shrinks, and end-to-end reliability suffers. We present a multi-agent system (MAS) prototype for hydrodynamics in which specialized agents are coordinated through a Layer Execution Graph (LEG). A planner agent constructs query-specific execution topologies from natural-language routing heuristics that capture domain knowledge without hard-coding it as rigid control logic; specialist agents operate under strict tool allowlists and occupy complementary data-class roles. Between layers, consolidator agents fuse parallel outputs into concise briefs, and a reporter agent synthesizes the final response, while the runtime logs provenance for every tool invocation to support auditability. All benchmarks, ablations, and stress tests use Claude Sonnet~4.6 as the backbone model for both specialist and general-purpose agents. Evaluated on 37 queries spanning six complexity categories, the prototype achieves 93.6% factual precision with a 100% pass rate. Accuracy remains above 90% across runs from single-threaded to five independent parallel tracks, and under simulated loss of individual data sources the system degrades gracefully, still returning substantive partial answers. Together, these results suggest that planner-guided, graph-structured multi-agent orchestration can meaningfully alleviate the context-saturation bottlenecks that constrain monolithic single-agent architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于层级执行图（LEG）的多智能体系统（MAS）用于流体动力学研究，通过规划器引导的图结构多智能体编排，有效缓解了单智能体系统中的上下文饱和瓶颈，在37个查询上实现了93.6%的事实准确率和100%的通过率。
AI.motivation: 单智能体系统（SAS）在LLM驱动的科学工作流中存在上下文饱和问题：随着工具规范和观测轨迹的累积，每个决策的有效上下文空间不断缩小，端到端可靠性下降。需要一种新的架构来缓解这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出多智能体系统（MAS）原型，核心组件包括：(1) 规划器（Planner）智能体，通过自然语言路由启发式构建查询特定的执行拓扑；(2) 专业智能体（Specialist agents），在严格的工具允许列表和数据类角色下运行；(3) 整合器（Consolidator agents），在层级间融合并行输出为简洁简报；(4) 报告器（Reporter agent），合成最终响应。运行时记录所有工具调用的来源信息以支持审计。
AI.result: 在37个覆盖六种复杂度类别的查询上，原型达到93.6%的事实准确率和100%的通过率。从单线程到五个独立并行轨道，准确率保持在90%以上。在模拟个别数据源丢失的情况下，系统优雅降级，仍能返回实质性部分答案。
AI.conclusion: 规划器引导的图结构多智能体编排可以有效缓解约束单体智能体架构的上下文饱和瓶颈，为LLM驱动的科学工作流提供更可靠的架构方案。

title: New Bounds for Zarankiewicz Numbers via Reinforced LLM Evolutionary Search
comment: *Jay Bhan and Nicole Nobili contributed equally to this work as first authors, and their order was determined via coin flip
summary: The Zarankiewicz number $\textbf{Z}(m, n, s, t)$ is the maximum number of edges in a bipartite graph $G_{m, n}$ such that there is no complete $K_{s, t}$ bipartite subgraph. We determine for the first time the exact values of three Zarankiewicz numbers: $\textbf{Z}(11, 21, 3, 3)=116$, $\textbf{Z}(11, 22, 3, 3)=121$, and $\textbf{Z}(12, 22, 3, 3)=132$. We further establish lower bounds for 41 more Zarankiewicz numbers, including several that are within one edge of the best known upper bound, and we match the established value in four more closed cases. Our results are obtained using OpenEvolve, an open-source evolutionary algorithm based on Large Language Models (LLMs) that iteratively improves algorithms for generating mathematical constructions by optimizing a reward signal which we tailored for this specific problem. These findings provide new extremal graph constructions and demonstrate the potential of LLM-guided evolutionary search to contribute to mathematical research. In addition to presenting the resulting constructions, we report the generation algorithms produced, describe the relevant implementation details, and provide our computational costs. Our costs are remarkably low, at less than \$30 for each Zarankiewicz parameter combination, showing that LLM-guided evolutionary search can be an inexpensive, reproducible, and accessible tool for discovering new combinatorial constructions.

AI.motivation: Zarankiewicz数（二分图中避免完全K_{s,t}子图的最大边数）是极值图论中的经典难题，长期以来精确值难以确定，现有方法计算成本高且效率有限。

AI.conclusion: LLM引导的进化搜索是一种低成本（每参数组合不到30美元）、可复现、易获取的工具，能够有效发现新的组合数学构造，展示了AI辅助数学研究的潜力。

title: PERSA: Reinforcement Learning for Professor-Style Personalized Feedback with LLMs
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables, accepted to conference ACL-2026, BEA
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can provide automated feedback in educational settings, but aligning an LLMs style with a specific instructors tone while maintaining diagnostic correctness remains challenging. We ask how can we update an LLM for automated feedback generation to align with a target instructors style without sacrificing core knowledge? We study how Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) can adapt a transformer-based LLM to generate programming feedback that matches a professors grading voice. We introduce PERSA, an RLHF pipeline that combines supervised fine-tuning on professor demonstrations, reward modeling from pairwise preferences, and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), while deliberately constraining learning to style-bearing components. Motivated by analyses of transformer internals, PERSA applies parameter efficient fine-tuning. It updates only the top transformer blocks and their feed-forward projections, minimizing global parameter drift while increasing stylistic controllability. We evaluate our proposed approach on three code-feedback benchmarks (APPS, PyFiXV, and CodeReviewQA) using complementary metrics for style alignment and fidelity. Across both Llama-3 and Gemma-2 backbones, PERSA delivers the strongest professor-style transfer while retaining correctness, for example on APPS, it boosts Style Alignment Score (SAC) to 96.2% (from 34.8% for Base) with Correctness Accuracy (CA) up to 100% on Llama-3, and Gemma-2. Overall, PERSA offers a practical route to personalized educational feedback by aligning both what it says (content correctness) and, crucially, how it says it (instructor-like tone and structure).

AI.result: 在APPS、PyFiXV、CodeReviewQA三个基准上，基于Llama-3和Gemma-2骨干网，PERSA实现最强教授风格迁移同时保持正确性。例如APPS上风格对齐分数(SAC)从Base的34.8%提升至96.2%，正确性准确率(CA)达100%。
AI.conclusion: PERSA提供了一条实用路径：通过选择性参数更新，在保持内容正确性的同时实现个性化教育反馈的风格对齐，兼顾"说什么"和"怎么说"。

title: Iterative Finetuning is Mostly Idempotent
summary: If a model has some behavioral tendency, such as sycophancy or misalignment, and it is trained on its own outputs, will the tendency be amplified in the next generation of models? We study this question by training a series of models where each model is finetuned on data generated by its predecessor, and the initial model is seeded with some persona or belief. We test three settings: supervised finetuning (SFT) on instruct models, synthetic document finetuning (SDF) on base models, and direct preference optimization (DPO). In the SFT and SDF settings, traits mostly decay or remain constant so that further finetuning cycles do nothing. In rare cases when amplification occurs, it generally comes at the cost of coherence. In the DPO setting, trait amplification can reliably occur when a model is continually trained with a preference for its own outputs, but vanishes when models are reinitialized at each cycle. Overall, our results suggest that amplification most likely comes from continual post-training, and limiting this stage may be an effective defense. For non-RL finetuning, trait amplification is rare and very sensitive to data quantity, making it significantly less likely to occur accidentally. Finally, the amplification-coherence tradeoff serves as a natural deterrent against trait amplification.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了模型在自身输出数据上训练时，行为倾向（如谄媚、失调）是否会在下一代模型中被放大。实验涵盖SFT、SDF和DPO三种训练方式，发现SFT/SDF中特质大多衰减或不变，DPO中特质放大可靠发生但依赖于持续训练，且放大会牺牲模型连贯性。
AI.motivation: 探究当模型在其自身生成的数据上训练时，原有的行为倾向（如谄媚或价值观失调）是否会被逐代放大，这是AI安全中关于自我训练导致倾向强化的重要问题。
AI.method: 设计系列实验：初始模型注入特定人格/信念，然后让每一代模型在其前一代的输出数据上微调。测试三种训练设定：有监督微调（SFT）、合成文档微调（SDF）、直接偏好优化（DPO）。
AI.result: SFT和SDF中特质大多衰减或保持不变；罕见放大情形中会牺牲模型连贯性。DPO中当模型持续偏好自身输出时，特质放大可稳定发生，但若每轮重新初始化则消失。
AI.conclusion: 特质放大最可能来自持续的post-training（如DPO），限制这一阶段是有效防御；非RL微调中特质放大罕见且对数据量敏感；放大与连贯性之间存在权衡，可作为自然抑制机制。
idea_en: A method for detecting and measuring behavioral trait amplification across model generations by seeding initial models with specific personas and tracking trait evolution through iterative self-training cycles.
A training protocol that uses coherence-trait amplification tradeoff as a natural regulatory mechanism to prevent undesired behavioral amplification in self-training.
A defense framework against trait amplification that limits continual post-training stages while allowing initial supervised finetuning.
A technique to differentiate between genuine trait amplification (requiring continual training) versus transient effects by reinitializing model weights between training cycles.
A data-sensitive trait amplification detection system for non-RL finetuning that quantifies the relationship between training data quantity and amplification probability.
idea_ch: 一种跨模型代际的行为倾向放大检测方法：通过向初始模型注入特定人格/信念，在迭代自训练循环中追踪倾向演变路径。
一种利用连贯性-倾向放大权衡作为天然调节机制的训练协议，防止自训练中出现非期待的行为倾向放大。
一种针对倾向放大的防御框架：允许初始有监督微调，但限制持续的post-training阶段（如DPO迭代）。
一种区分真正特质放大（需持续训练）与短暂效应的方法：在每轮训练周期之间重新初始化模型权重。
一种面向非RL微调的数据敏感型倾向放大检测系统，量化训练数据量与放大概率之间的关联关系。

title: To Use AI as Dice of Possibilities with Timing Computation
summary:
The dominant noun-based modeling paradigm has fundamentally constrained AI development, precluding any adequate representation of the future as an open temporal dimension. This paper introduces a verb-based paradigm, together with precise definitions of \emph{timing computation} and \emph{possibility}, that enables AI to function as an effective instrument for realizing the grammar of our thought.
  Applied to longitudinal EHR data from 3,276 breast cancer patients, the framework empirically demonstrates: (1) automatic discovery of clinically significant patient trajectories, and (2) counterfactual timing deduction. Both results are purely data-driven, require no prior domain knowledge, and, to our knowledge, represent the first such demonstrations in the machine learning literature.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于动词（verb-based）的AI建模范式，取代传统的基于名词（noun-based）范式，通过"时序计算"和"可能性"的精确定义，使AI能够表达未来作为开放时间维度的特性。在3276名乳腺癌患者的纵向EHR数据上，该方法实现了临床显著患者轨迹的自动发现和反事实时序推理。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于名词的建模范式无法充分表达未来作为开放时间维度的特性，限制了AI的发展。需要一种新的范式来更好地表示时间动态和可能性。
AI.method: 提出动词-based范式，定义时序计算(timing computation)和可能性(possibility)的精确数学定义，应用于纵向EHR数据的分析。
AI.result: 在3276名乳腺癌患者数据上：(1)自动发现临床有意义的患者轨迹；(2)实现反事实时序推理。两者均为纯数据驱动，无需领域知识。
AI.conclusion: 动词-based范式能更有效地表征思维语法，特别是在处理时间维度和可能性方面，为AI开辟了新方向。
idea_en: 1. A verb-based AI modeling paradigm replacing traditional noun-based approaches for temporal data representation and reasoning.
2. A precise mathematical definition of 'timing computation' enabling AI to represent future as an open temporal dimension.
3. A formal definition of 'possibility' within the verb-based framework for counterfactual reasoning.
4. A fully data-driven method for automatic discovery of clinically significant patient trajectories from longitudinal EHR data without prior domain knowledge.
5. A counterfactual timing deduction system that computes alternative temporal outcomes purely from observational data.
idea_ch: 1. 基于动词的AI建模范式：用动词替代名词作为基本语义单元，实现对时间动态和未来可能性的有效表征。
2. 时序计算（Timing Computation）的精确数学定义：将未来视为开放时间维度进行建模计算的方法。
3. 可能性（Possibility）的形式化定义：在动词框架下定义不确定性和反事实推理的数学基础。
4. 纯数据驱动的患者轨迹自动发现方法：无需任何先验领域知识，从纵向EHR数据中自动挖掘临床有意义的患者发展路径。
5. 反事实时序推理系统：仅基于观测数据，计算替代时间线/反事实结局的技术方案。

title: A Low-Latency Fraud Detection Layer for Detecting Adversarial Interaction Patterns in LLM-Powered Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-powered agents demonstrate strong capabilities in autonomous task execution, tool use, and multi-step reasoning. However, their increasing autonomy also introduces a new attack surface: adversarial interactions can manipulate agent behavior through direct prompt injection, indirect content attacks, and multi-turn escalation strategies. Existing defense strategies focus on prompt-level filtering and rule-based guardrails, which are often insufficient when risk emerges gradually across interaction sequences. In this work, we propose a complementary defense mechanism: a low-latency fraud detection layer for detecting adversarial interaction patterns in LLM-powered agents. Instead of determining whether a single prompt is malicious, our approach models risk over interaction trajectories using structured runtime features derived from prompt characteristics, session dynamics, tool usage, execution context, and fraud-inspired signals. The detection layer can be implemented using lightweight models leading to low-latency real-time deployments. To evaluate the framework, we construct a synthetic corpus of 12,000 multi-turn agent interactions generated from parameterized templates that simulate realistic agentic workflows. Using 42 structured features and an XGBoost classifier, our detector achieves over 9 times faster than LLM-based detectors. Through the experiment and ablation studies, our work suggests that interaction-level behavioral detection should become a core component of deployment-time defense for LLM-powered agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于检测LLM代理中对抗性交互模式的低延迟欺诈检测层，通过交互轨迹级别的结构化特征建模风险，使用42维特征和XGBoost分类器实现比LLM检测器快9倍以上的实时检测。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的代理在自主任务执行中面临新的攻击面（直接提示注入、间接内容攻击、多轮升级策略），现有基于单提示过滤和规则防御的方法不足以应对跨交互序列逐渐显现的风险。
AI.method: 提出一种低延迟欺诈检测层：从提示特征、会话动态、工具使用、执行上下文和欺诈信号五个维度提取42个结构化运行时特征，使用XGBoost轻量级分类器对多轮交互轨迹进行风险建模，而非判断单条提示是否恶意。构建了12,000条多轮代理交互的合成语料库进行训练和评估。
AI.result: 基于XGBoost的检测器比LLM-based检测器快9倍以上，在合成数据集上展示了有效的检测能力。
AI.conclusion: 交互级别的行为检测应成为LLM代理部署时防御的核心组件，该方法可作为现有提示级过滤和规则防护的补充防御机制。
idea_en: A fraud detection framework for LLM-powered agents that models risk over multi-turn interaction trajectories instead of analyzing single prompts, using structured runtime features including prompt characteristics, session dynamics, tool usage, execution context, and fraud-inspired signals.
A lightweight real-time detection system for adversarial agent interactions using 42 structured features and an XGBoost classifier, achieving 9x faster performance than LLM-based detectors.

A parameterized template-based method for generating synthetic multi-turn agent interaction datasets (12,000 interactions) that simulate realistic agentic workflows for training adversarial pattern detectors.

A multi-dimensional feature extraction method for agent runtime behavior including prompt-level signals, session-level temporal patterns, tool invocation sequences, and fraud-detection inspired metrics.
idea_ch: 一种基于交互轨迹风险建模的LLM代理欺诈检测框架，通过提示特征、会话动态、工具使用、执行上下文和欺诈信号等结构化运行时特征，替代传统的单条提示恶意检测方法。
一种使用42维结构化特征和XGBoost分类器的轻量级实时检测系统，用于检测LLM代理中的对抗性交互模式，性能比基于LLM的检测器快9倍以上。
一种基于参数化模板的合成多轮代理交互数据集生成方法，可生成12,000条模拟真实工作流的交互数据，用于训练对抗模式检测器。
一种代理运行时行为的多维特征提取方法，包含提示级信号、会话级时间模式、工具调用序列和欺诈检测启发的度量指标。

title: Position: Safety and Fairness in Agentic AI Depend on Interaction Topology, Not on Model Scale or Alignment
summary: As large language models are increasingly deployed as interacting agents in high-stakes decisions, the AI safety community assumes that safety properties of individual models will compose into safe multi-agent behavior. This position paper argues that this assumption is fundamentally mistaken. In agentic AI, safety is determined by interaction topology, not model weights. When agents deliberate sequentially or aggregate via parallel voting with a judge, the structure of information flow and decision coupling dominates outcomes. Evidence across model families and scales reveals three persistent topology-driven pathologies: ordering instability, where system behavior depends primarily on agent sequence; information cascades, where early judgments propagate regardless of correctness; and functional collapse, where systems satisfy fairness metrics while abandoning meaningful risk discrimination. Contrary to intuition, scaling to more capable models strengthens these effects by increasing consensus formation and reducing the challenge of initial decisions. These failure modes are invisible to model-centric evaluation and alignment procedures. We argue that agentic AI must be treated as a dynamical system rather than a collection of aligned components. Interaction topology must become a primary target of safety evaluation and regulation, with systems required to demonstrate robustness across architectural variations before deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，在多智能体AI系统中，安全性由交互拓扑结构决定，而非单个模型的权重。研究发现三种拓扑驱动病理现象：排序不稳定性、信息级联和功能崩溃，且更强的模型会加剧这些效应。作者主张将智能体AI视为动力系统，交互拓扑应成为安全评估和监管的主要目标。
AI.motivation: 挑战AI安全社区的一个核心假设——单个模型的安全属性会组合成安全的多智能体行为，指出这一假设在智能体AI中根本错误。
AI.method: 通过跨模型家族和规模的多智能体系统实验，分析不同交互拓扑结构（顺序推理、并行投票+裁判）下的系统行为，识别并验证三种拓扑驱动病理现象。
AI.result: 发现三种持续存在的拓扑驱动病理：排序不稳定性（系统行为主要取决于智能体顺序）、信息级联（早期判断无论正确与否都会传播）、功能崩溃（系统满足公平性指标但放弃有意义的风险区分）。更强的模型会增强这些效应。
AI.conclusion: 智能体AI必须被视为动力系统而非对齐组件的集合，交互拓扑应成为安全评估和监管的主要目标，系统在部署前需证明跨架构变体的鲁棒性。
idea_en: A method for evaluating multi-agent system safety by analyzing interaction topology rather than individual model alignment, identifying ordering instability, information cascades, and functional collapse as safety-critical failure modes.

A system and method for detecting information cascade pathologies in sequential agent deliberation, where early agent judgments propagate regardless of correctness, with monitoring mechanisms to halt or redirect cascades.

A technique for measuring topological robustness of multi-agent systems by testing behavior across different agent ordering permutations, voting configurations, and judge architectures before deployment.

A safety regulation framework for agentic AI systems that requires demonstration of robustness across architectural variations, treating the system as a dynamical system rather than a collection of aligned components.

A method for preventing functional collapse in multi-agent systems that satisfy fairness metrics but abandon meaningful risk discrimination, by introducing controlled diversity or adversarial agent roles.
idea_ch: 一种通过分析交互拓扑而非单个模型对齐来评估多智能体系统安全性的方法，识别排序不稳定性、信息级联和功能崩溃作为安全关键失效模式。
一种检测顺序智能体推演中信息级联病理的系统和方法，其中早期智能体判断无论正确与否都会传播，配备监控机制以暂停或重定向级联。
一种通过在不同智能体排序排列、投票配置和裁判架构下测试行为来测量多智能体系统拓扑鲁棒性的技术。
一种智能体AI系统安全监管框架，要求系统在部署前证明跨架构变体的鲁棒性，将系统视为动力系统而非对齐组件的集合。
一种防止多智能体系统中功能崩溃的方法，该系统满足公平性指标但放弃有意义的风险区分，通过引入可控多样性或对抗性智能体角色来实现。

title: Arithmetic in the Wild: Llama uses Base-10 Addition to Reason About Cyclic Concepts
summary: Does structure in representations imply structure in computation? We study how Llama-3.1-8B reasons over cyclic concepts (e.g., "what month is six months after August?"). Even though Llama-3.1-8B's representations for these concepts are circularly structured, we find that instead of directly computing modular addition in the period of the cyclic concept (e.g., 12 for months), the model re-uses a generic addition mechanism across tasks that operates independently of concept-specific geometry. First, it computes the sum of its two inputs using base-10 addition (six + August=14). Then, it maps this sum back to cyclic concept space (14->February). We show that Llama-3.1-8B uses task-agnostic Fourier features to compute these sums--in fact, these features have periods that respect standard base-10 addition, e.g., 2, 5, and 10, rather than the cyclic concept period (e.g., 12 for months). Furthermore, we identify a sparse set of 28 MLP neurons re-used across all tasks (approximately 0.2% of the MLP at layer 18) that can be partitioned into disjoint clusters, each computing the sum for a Fourier feature with a different period. Our work highlights how an interplay between causal abstraction and feature geometry can deepen our mechanistic understanding of LMs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究Llama-3.1-8B模型如何处理循环概念推理（如月份计算），发现模型并未直接使用循环概念周期进行模加法，而是复用了一种通用的基-10加法机制，并通过任务无关的傅里叶特征计算和，最后映射回循环概念空间。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型在推理循环概念时，其表征的结构（循环结构）是否直接对应于计算的结构（模加法），即表征几何与计算机制之间的关系。
AI.method: 通过分析Llama-3.1-8B在月份等循环概念推理任务中的内部机制，识别出模型使用基-10加法（而非模12加法），并利用任务无关的傅里叶特征（周期为2,5,10等）进行计算，同时定位到第18层中28个稀疏MLP神经元作为关键计算单元。
AI.result: 模型表征是循环结构，但计算机制是通用的基-10加法，而非针对循环周期的模加法；识别出28个MLP神经元（约0.2%的MLP）被跨任务复用，可分成不同周期傅里叶特征的计算集群。
AI.conclusion: 表征的结构不一定直接映射到计算的结构，因果抽象与特征几何的相互作用能加深对语言模型机制的理解。
idea_en: A method for cross-task generic addition mechanism in large language models using task-agnostic Fourier features for arithmetic reasoning over cyclic concepts
A system for sparse neuron cluster identification and partitioning in transformer MLP layers that compute sums for Fourier features with different periods
A technique for mapping base-10 addition results back to cyclic concept space (e.g., months, time cycles) in language model inference
An approach to decouple representation structure from computation structure in neural networks, enabling reusable arithmetic modules across tasks
A method for detecting and leveraging Fourier features with periods (2, 5, 10) that respect standard base-10 addition rather than task-specific cyclic periods
idea_ch: 一种利用任务无关傅里叶特征在大语言模型中实现跨任务通用加法机制的循环概念推理方法
一种在Transformer MLP层中识别和划分稀疏神经元集群的系统，用于计算不同周期的傅里叶特征求和
一种将基-10加法结果映射回循环概念空间（如月份、时间周期）的语言模型推理技术
一种解耦神经网络中表征结构与计算结构的方法，实现跨任务可复用的算术模块
一种检测和利用周期为2、5、10的傅里叶特征的方法，这些特征遵循标准基-10加法而非任务特定循环周期

title: LLMs Should Not Yet Be Credited with Decision Explanation
summary: This position paper argues that LLMs should not yet be credited with decision explanation. This matters because recent work increasingly treats accurate behavioral prediction, plausible rationales, and outcome-conditioned reasoning traces as evidence that LLMs explain why people decide as they do, risking a premature redefinition of what counts as explanatory progress in human decision modeling. We first distinguish three claims with different evidential burdens: decision prediction, rationale generation, and decision explanation. We then argue that the evidence most commonly offered for LLM-based decision accounts directly supports the first two claims, and sometimes explanatory hypothesis generation, but does not distinguish decision explanation from prediction-supportive rationalization. Next, we propose a bridge standard for decision-explanation credit: stronger claims should specify explanatory targets, discriminate against weaker rationalizer alternatives, use target-appropriate process- or intervention-sensitive validation, and bound their scope. We then situate this standard against competing views and related literatures, clarifying why it preserves the value of LLMs as predictors, narrators, and hypothesis generators while resisting premature explanatory credit. We conclude with a principle of credit calibration: LLMs should be credited for the strongest claim their evidence warrants, and no stronger; if adopted, this principle can help turn LLMs from persuasive narrators of decisions into more reliable instruments for discovering, testing, and communicating explanations of human behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文论证LLM目前不应被赋予决策解释的“功劳”，指出准确的行为预测、合理的理由和基于结果条件的推理痕迹不能等同于真正的决策解释，并提出了一个“功劳校准”原则。
AI.motivation: 近期研究越来越多地将LLM的准确行为预测、看似合理的理由生成和基于结果条件的推理链视为LLM能够解释人类决策的证据，这可能导致过早地重新定义什么算作人类决策建模中的解释性进展。
AI.method: 本文通过概念辨析（区分决策预测、理由生成和决策解释三种不同主张）、论证分析（指出现有证据支持前两种主张但不能区分真正的解释与支持预测的合理化）、提出桥接标准（要求明确解释目标、区分弱合理化替代方案、使用过程敏感或干预敏感的验证方法、限定范围）以及理论定位（与竞争观点和相关文献对照）来进行论证。
AI.result: 提出了一个“功劳校准”原则：LLM应被赋予其证据所支持的最强主张的功劳，而非更强的功劳。
AI.conclusion: 如果采纳功劳校准原则，可帮助LLM从有说服力的决策叙述者转变为发现、测试和沟通人类行为解释的更可靠工具。
idea_en: A bridge standard for decision-explanation credit that requires specifying explanatory targets, discriminating against weaker rationalizer alternatives, using target-appropriate process- or intervention-sensitive validation, and bounding scope.
A credit calibration principle for LLMs where they are credited for the strongest claim their evidence warrants and no stronger, preventing premature attribution of explanatory capabilities.
A methodological framework distinguishing decision prediction, rationale generation, and decision explanation as three claims with different evidential burdens.
idea_ch: 一种决策解释功劳的桥接标准，要求明确解释目标、区分弱合理化替代方案、使用目标适当的过程敏感或干预敏感验证方法、并限定适用范围。
LLM功劳校准原则：LLM应被赋予其证据所支持的最强主张的功劳，而非更强的功劳，防止过早赋予解释能力。
区分决策预测、理由生成和决策解释三种不同主张的方法论框架，每种主张具有不同的证据负担要求。

title: NEURON: A Neuro-symbolic System for Grounded Clinical Explainability
summary: Clinical AI adoption is hindered by the black-box/grey-box nature of high-performing models, which lack the ontological grounding and narrative transparency required for professional-level explainability. We present NEURON, a neuro-symbolic system designed to enhance both predictive reliability and clinical interpretability. NEURON integrates SNOMED CT ontology-informed structural representations with machine learning models to bridge the gap between raw data and medical nomenclature. To facilitate human-aligned interaction, the system utilizes a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) grounded LLM layer to synthesize SHAP feature attributions and patient-specific clinical notes into coherent, natural-language explanations. Validated on the MIMIC-IV dataset for Acute Heart Failure mortality prediction, NEURON improved the AUC from 0.74-0.77 to 0.84-0.88 and significantly outperformed raw SHAP visualizations in human-aligned metrics (0.85 vs. 0.50). Our results demonstrate that NEURON offers a robust, scalable engineering solution for deploying trustworthy, human-centered connected health applications.

AI.tldr: NEURON是一个神经符号系统，结合SNOMED CT本体、机器学习和RAG-LLM，用于提高临床AI的可解释性和预测性能，在急性心衰死亡率预测中显著提升了AUC和人类对齐指标。
AI.motivation: 临床AI模型虽性能高但呈黑箱/灰箱特性，缺乏本体论基础和叙事透明度，难以满足专业级的可解释性需求，阻碍了临床采纳。
AI.method: 1) 使用SNOMED CT本体构建结构化表示，桥接原始数据与医学术语；2) 集成机器学习模型进行预测；3) 利用RAG增强的LLM层，将SHAP特征归因与患者临床笔记合成为自然语言解释。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-IV数据集上，急性心衰死亡率预测AUC从0.74-0.77提升至0.84-0.88；人类对齐指标上显著优于原始SHAP可视化（0.85 vs. 0.50）。
AI.conclusion: NEURON提供了一种稳健可扩展的工程解决方案，用于部署可信赖的、以人为中心的互联健康应用。
idea_en: A neuro-symbolic system integrating SNOMED CT ontology with machine learning for enhanced predictive reliability and clinical interpretability.
A RAG-grounded LLM layer that synthesizes SHAP feature attributions and patient-specific clinical notes into coherent natural-language explanations.
A method for bridging raw clinical data with medical nomenclature using ontology-informed structural representations to improve model transparency.
A human-aligned interpretability framework that significantly outperforms raw SHAP visualizations in clinical trustworthiness metrics (0.85 vs. 0.50).
idea_ch: 一种将SNOMED CT本体与机器学习集成的神经符号系统，用于增强预测可靠性和临床可解释性。
一种基于RAG的LLM层，将SHAP特征归因与患者特定临床笔记合成为连贯的自然语言解释。
一种利用本体引导的结构化表示桥接原始临床数据与医学术语的方法，以提高模型透明度。
一种人类对齐的可解释性框架，在临床可信度指标上显著优于原始SHAP可视化（0.85对0.50）。

title: GR-Ben: A General Reasoning Benchmark for Evaluating Process Reward Models
summary: Currently, process reward models (PRMs) have exhibited remarkable potential for test-time scaling. Since large language models (LLMs) regularly generate flawed intermediate reasoning steps when tackling a broad spectrum of reasoning and decision-making tasks, PRMs are required to possess capabilities for detecting process-level errors in real-world scenarios. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on mathematical reasoning, thereby failing to comprehensively evaluate the error detection ability of PRMs across diverse reasoning scenarios. To mitigate this gap, we introduce GR-Ben, a process-level benchmark specifically designed for assessing PRM's performance across two primary reasoning domains (science and logic) and nine subdomains. We conduct extensive experiments on a diverse set of 22 models, encompassing both PRMs and LLMs, and derive two key findings: (1) In domains beyond mathematical reasoning, the error-detection ability of existing PRMs and LLMs is found to be markedly weaker by comparison.(2) In general, PRMs are less adept at identifying knowledge-based errors, whereas LLMs exhibit poorer performance in detecting computational errors.We hope GR-Ben can foster future researches on PRMs for general domains, thereby enhancing the reasoning capabilities of LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GR-Ben基准，用于评估过程奖励模型（PRM）在科学和逻辑等非数学推理领域的错误检测能力，发现现有PRM和LLM在非数学领域表现显著较弱，且PRM难以识别知识错误，LLM则难以检测计算错误。
AI.motivation: 现有PRM基准主要聚焦数学推理，无法全面评估PRM在多样化推理场景中的错误检测能力，亟需覆盖科学、逻辑等更广泛领域的评估基准。
AI.method: 构建GR-Ben基准，覆盖科学和逻辑两大推理领域、九个子领域；在22个模型（含PRM和LLM）上进行广泛实验。
AI.result: (1) 在数学之外的推理领域，现有PRM和LLM的错误检测能力显著较弱；(2) PRM更难识别知识型错误，LLM在检测计算错误上表现更差。
AI.conclusion: GR-Ben可促进通用领域PRM研究，提升LLM的推理能力。
idea_en: A process-level error detection benchmark (GR-Ben) spanning science and logic domains beyond mathematics for evaluating process reward models (PRMs).
A method for systematically categorizing intermediate reasoning errors into knowledge-based errors and computation-based errors for targeted PRM evaluation.
A multi-domain evaluation framework that tests PRMs across 9 subdomains (e.g., physics, chemistry, biology, formal logic, etc.) for comprehensive error detection assessment.
A comparative analysis technique revealing that PRMs and LLMs have complementary error detection weaknesses, enabling hybrid error detection systems.
idea_ch: 一种跨数学之外的科学与逻辑领域的PRM过程级错误检测基准（GR-Ben）。
一种将中间推理错误系统分类为知识型错误和计算型错误，用于针对性评估PRM的方法。
一种多领域评估框架，覆盖9个子领域（如物理、化学、生物、形式逻辑等）以全面检测PRM错误识别能力。
一种利用PRM与LLM在错误检测上互补性弱点的混合错误检测系统设计思路。

title: Faithful Mobile GUI Agents with Guided Advantage Estimator
summary: Vision-language model based graphical user interface (GUI) agents have shown strong interaction capabilities. However, they often behave unfaithfully, relying on memorized shortcuts rather than grounding actions in displayed screen evidence or user instructions. To address this, we propose Faithful-Agent, a faithfulness-first framework that reformulates GUI interaction to prioritize evidence groundedness and internal consistency. Faithful-Agent employs a two-stage pipeline: (i) a faithfulness-oriented SFT stage to instill abstainment behaviors under evidence perturbations; (ii) an RFT stage that further amplifies faithfulness by introducing the guided advantage estimator (GuAE), an anchor-based and variance-adaptive advantage tempering mechanism built upon GRPO. GuAE prevents advantage collapse in low-variance rollout groups under sparse GUI rewards, and with a thought-action consistency reward, Faithful-Agent (Stage II) elevates the Trap SR from 13.88\% to 80.21\% relative to the baseline, while preserving robust general instruction-following performance.

AI.tldr: 提出Faithful-Agent框架，通过两阶段训练（SFT+RFT）提升GUI智能体的忠实度，解决其依赖捷径而非屏幕证据的问题。核心创新包括引导优势估计器（GuAE）和思维-行动一致性奖励，将陷阱成功率从13.88%提升至80.21%。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉语言模型的GUI智能体常表现出不忠实行为——依赖记忆化捷径而非屏幕证据或用户指令来执行动作，导致交互不可靠。
AI.method: 两阶段流水线：(i) 忠实导向的SFT阶段，通过证据扰动训练智能体学会"弃权"行为；(ii) RFT阶段，引入引导优势估计器（GuAE），一种基于锚点和方差自适应的优势调节机制，构建于GRPO之上。同时设计思维-行动一致性奖励。
AI.result: 相比基线，Faithful-Agent（阶段II）将陷阱成功率（Trap SR）从13.88%提升至80.21%，同时保持鲁棒的通用指令跟随性能。
AI.conclusion: Faithful-Agent框架有效提升了GUI智能体的忠实度，在不牺牲通用性能的前提下大幅改善了证据基础性和内部一致性。
idea_en: A two-stage faithfulness-first pipeline for GUI agents: Stage I uses faithfulness-oriented SFT with evidence perturbations to instill abstainment behaviors; Stage II applies reinforcement fine-tuning with a guided advantage estimator (GuAE).

Guided Advantage Estimator (GuAE): an anchor-based and variance-adaptive advantage tempering mechanism built upon GRPO that prevents advantage collapse in low-variance rollout groups under sparse GUI rewards.
Thought-action consistency reward mechanism that penalizes mismatches between the agent's reasoning trace and its actual action, ensuring internal consistency.
Evidence perturbation training strategy that systematically alters screen evidence during SFT to teach the agent when to abstain from action rather than relying on memorized shortcuts.
A framework that reformulates GUI interaction to prioritize evidence groundedness, enabling agents to base actions on displayed screen evidence rather than learned heuristics.
idea_ch: 一种两阶段忠实优先的GUI智能体流水线：第一阶段通过忠实导向的SFT结合证据扰动训练弃权行为；第二阶段采用引导优势估计器（GuAE）进行强化微调。
引导优势估计器（GuAE）：基于GRPO的锚点式和方差自适应优势调节机制，防止稀疏GUI奖励下低方差 rollout 组的优势坍塌问题。
思维-行动一致性奖励机制：惩罚智能体推理轨迹与实际动作之间的不匹配，确保内部一致性。
证据扰动训练策略：在SFT阶段系统性地改变屏幕证据，训练智能体在缺乏依据时主动弃权而非依赖记忆化捷径。
一种重构GUI交互优先级的框架，强调动作基于屏幕证据基础性，使智能体依据显示证据而非学习启发式执行操作。

title: Agentic AI Systems Should Be Designed as Marginal Token Allocators
summary: This position paper argues that agentic AI systems should be designed and evaluated as \emph{marginal token allocation economies} rather than as text generators priced by the unit. We follow a single request -- a developer asking a coding agent to fix a failing test -- through four economic layers that today are designed in isolation: a router that decides which model answers, an agent that decides whether to plan, act, verify, or defer, a serving stack that decides how to produce each token, and a training pipeline that decides whether the trace is worth learning from. We show that all four layers are solving the \emph{same} first-order condition -- marginal benefit equals marginal cost plus latency cost plus risk cost -- with different index sets and different prices. The framing is deliberately minimal: we do not propose a complete theory of AI economics. But adopting marginal token allocation as the shared accounting object explains why systems that locally minimize tokens globally misallocate them, predicts a small set of recurring failure modes (over-routing, over-delegation, under-verification, serving congestion, stale rollouts, cache misuse), and points to a concrete research agenda in token-aware evaluation, autonomy pricing, congestion-priced serving, and risk-adjusted RL budgeting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出应将智能体AI系统设计为"边际令牌分配经济体"，而非按单位定价的文本生成器。通过追踪一个编码代理修复测试失败的单一请求，穿越路由器、智能体、服务栈和训练流水线四个经济层，论证各层都在解决相同的边际效益等于边际成本加延迟成本加风险成本的一阶条件，并预测了过度路由、过度委托、验证不足等失效模式，提出了令牌感知评估、自主性定价等研究方向。
AI.motivation: 当前AI系统各层（路由、智能体决策、服务部署、训练）独立设计，缺乏统一的经济学框架来评估和优化令牌分配，导致局部优化而全局失衡的问题。
AI.method: 采用边际令牌分配经济学的框架，将各层的决策问题统一为边际效益等于边际成本加延迟成本加风险成本的一阶条件，通过单一请求的四个经济层追踪进行论证。
AI.result: 揭示了局部最小化令牌导致全局错误分配的机理，预测了过度路由、过度委托、验证不足、服务拥塞、陈旧部署、缓存误用等失效模式。
AI.conclusion: 提出了令牌感知评估、自主性定价、拥塞定价服务和风险调整的强化学习预算等具体研究方向。
idea_en: Marginal token allocation economy framework for agentic AI systems where each token's production is priced by marginal cost, latency cost, and risk cost across routing, agentic, serving, and training layers.
Token-aware evaluation metric that measures not just output quality but also the economic efficiency of token allocation across different layers.
Autonomy pricing mechanism for agentic AI that dynamically adjusts the cost of delegating decisions to the agent based on expected marginal benefit.
Congestion-priced serving stack that adjusts token production pricing based on real-time system load and queue lengths.
Risk-adjusted reinforcement learning budgeting method that incorporates marginal risk cost into RL training pipeline decisions about which traces are worth learning from.
Cross-layer token accounting system that tracks marginal costs and benefits of each token across router, agent, serving, and training layers to enable global optimization.
idea_ch: 面向智能体AI系统的边际令牌分配经济体框架，在路由、智能体、服务和训练各层中，每个令牌的生产按边际成本、延迟成本和风险成本定价。
令牌感知评估指标，不仅衡量输出质量，还衡量各层之间令牌分配的经济效率。
智能体自主性定价机制，基于预期边际效益动态调整将决策委托给智能体的成本。
拥塞定价服务栈，根据实时系统负载和队列长度调整令牌生产的定价。
风险调整的强化学习预算方法，将边际风险成本纳入训练流水线，决定哪些轨迹值得学习。
跨层令牌记账系统，追踪每个令牌在路由、智能体、服务和训练层的边际成本和效益，实现全局优化。

title: Zero-Shot Signal Temporal Logic Planning with Disjunctive Branch Selection in Dynamic Semantic Maps
summary: Signal Temporal Logic (STL) offers verifiable task specifications and is crucial for safety-critical control. Yet STL planning remains challenging: exact optimization-based methods are often too slow, and learning-based methods struggle to generalize across varying environments. We propose a zero-shot STL planning solver for variable-map environments that generates feasible trajectories without retraining. By integrating a map-conditioned Transformer architecture with a lightweight heuristic, our approach effectively handles complex disjunctive (OR) subformulas. Furthermore, we leverage Transitive Reinforcement Learning (TRL) to ensure consistent temporal grounding and logical coherence across decomposed sub-tasks. Experiments on dynamic semantic maps with diverse obstacle layouts demonstrate consistent gains, highlighting the framework's superior zero-shot generalization to changing environments and broad STL coverage.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于Transformer和传递强化学习的零样本STL规划求解器，能够在无需重新训练的情况下处理可变地图环境中的复杂任务规范。
AI.motivation: 现有STL规划方法面临两难：精确优化方法速度太慢，而学习方法难以在不同环境中泛化。需要一种既能满足STL规范又能零样本泛化到新环境的方法。
AI.method: 1) 地图条件Transformer架构 2) 轻量级启发式处理析取(OR)子公式 3) 传递强化学习(TRL)确保跨子任务的时间一致性和逻辑连贯性
AI.result: 在动态语义地图和多样障碍物布局的实验上持续优于基线，展现了优异的零样本泛化能力和广泛的STL覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效结合了Transformer的表达能力与TRL的逻辑一致性，为安全关键控制中的STL规划提供了一种可泛化的零样本求解方案。
idea_en: A zero-shot STL planning solver using map-conditioned Transformer architecture that generates feasible trajectories in variable-map environments without retraining
Integration of lightweight heuristic with Transformer for handling complex disjunctive (OR) subformulas in STL specifications
Application of Transitive Reinforcement Learning (TRL) to ensure consistent temporal grounding and logical coherence across decomposed sub-tasks in STL planning
idea_ch: 一种基于地图条件Transformer架构的零样本STL规划求解器，可在可变地图环境中无需重新训练即可生成可行轨迹
将轻量级启发式与Transformer相结合，用于处理STL规范中复杂的析取(OR)子公式
应用传递强化学习(TRL)确保STL规划中分解子任务间一致的时间基础化和逻辑连贯性
